g.title: legend
g.text: Blue dashed: planned bidirectional BGP EVPN Type-2
Gray dashed: OVN desired state / observation / OVS configuration
Gray dotted: Node-Agent API and reconciliation
Orange dotted: planned OVS/VTEP tunnel-port association, not forwarding
Importer does not write SBDB or OVS OpenFlow
Green dashed: planned, unvalidated VXLAN forwarding
